easyPrerequisites: You have three or more opponents.
description:
Activate Scholar of Athreos by paying {2}{W}, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
